report.explanation: All checkout observations are HTTP 200 with 63-94ms durations; gateway p95 for /v1/checkout is ~98ms and 502 count is 0. Traces show successful downstream calls (inventory, payment, order, redis, postgres) with no errors. No fault is established by current evidence; the alert reflects healthy latency, so no bounded root cause can be substantiated.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency SLO/threshold for /v1/checkout to determine whether 63-94ms is anomalous
